FULL TEXT:
PU-ISSER, PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
Panjab University-Institute of Social Sciences Education and Research
Applications are invited for one post of Guest Faculty in the subject of Psychology (for
Academic Session 2023-24) at PU-ISSER. Applications to reach the PU-ISSER office by August
31st, 2023. The department will not be responsible for any delays or non receipt of
application.
Eligibility criteria: Essential qualifications: As per UGC and Panjab University guidelines for
the appointment of Assistant Professor.
1. Good academic record with at least of 55% marks in M.A.(50 % for SC/ST candidates)
2. UGC NET cleared (in Psychology) for Assistant Professorship in the subject for one post
in Psychology must fulfill the other UGC regulations for recruitment and appointment
of Assistant Professor in University.
3. Desirable qualifications
a) Adequate knowledge of computer(Microsoft office)
b) Proficiency in Research methodology & Statistics
Application will be accepted on plain paper and should include the following details:
1. Name
2. Date of Birth
3. Recent Passport size photograph
4. Educational Qualifications (with percentage from 10th onwards)(Attach self
attested photocopies of the certificates)
5. Self Attested photocopies of Degrees
6. Research experience(Attach details with copy)
7. Teaching Experience (attach detailed documents)
8. Publications (attach details with copy of proof related to per reviewed/UGC case
list, national /international publication etc.)
9. Projects completed and ongoing(attach details with copy)
10. Other qualifications/skills
11. Correspondence and permanent address
12. Contact No./Mobile No. & E-mail ID
Honorarium and work details:
The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/-
per lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have
to give undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any
financial assistance from any agency during the period of teaching assignment at
PU-ISSER
 Working hours will be from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm Monday to Friday
 Classes/Subjects/Papers to be taught as per requirement.
Note:
1. All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other
relevant documents for verification along with the duly filed application
form at the time of interview.
2. No additional documents will be accepted after the submission of
application.
3. Eligibility for the said posts will be determined on the basis of documents
received on or before the last date and after verification of the original
documents.
4. The tenure of the above said posts can be varied
5. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates appearing for the interview.
6. Applicants are advised to check the Online Notice Board of the
department https://isser.puchd.ac.in/show-noticeboard.php?nbid=1 for
updates.
7. Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview and informed via their
respective emails.
Coordinator
PU-ISSER
